observations: SLES appears second, followed by Cocamidopropyl Betaine and salt.
Three botanical oils appear before fragrance, suggesting a meaningful oil/refatting signal for a rinse-off shampoo.
Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride supplies a cationic polymer deposition route.
Hydrolyzed Keratin is present late and should be treated as weak surface-film support.
No silicone or recognized anti-dandruff active is listed.

Post-unblind score adjustment: conditioningDeposition [2,3] -> [3,3] and weightBuildup [2,2] -> [3,3], because the revealed Oil-Repair positioning plus early three-oil complex and cationic guar support two distinct substantive deposition route kinds under v1.4; cleansing is not used to cancel deposition.

claims.textVerbatim: Pflege-Formel mit 3-fach Öl-Komplex und Keratin; für extrem strapaziertes und trockenes Haar; ohne Silikone.

cleansingStrength.rationale: SLES steht direkt nach Wasser und wird durch CAPB sowie Glutamate ergänzt; die Öl-/Refattinglast ändert die Reinigungsstärke nicht zu niedrig, daher bleibt die direkte Reinigung stark.

supportingSignals.observation: SLES + CAPB + Glutamate liefern eine starke, aber nicht resetartige Reinigungsbasis.
